style: Modern pixel art with soft lighting (Style D): an armored cave lizard with dark scales, a bony head plate and a long tail, a clean dark outline, chunky readable pixels, gentle highlights and shading. Match the character, colours and proportions of the reference image exactly. Side view, the creature facing right. Draw only the creature: no ground, no thread, no rope, no shadow, no effects.

frames.name: idle_1
frames.prompt: The same lizard standing at rest, head level, tail low, alert.

frames.name: idle_2
frames.prompt: The same lizard breathing: chest slightly raised, head a touch lower.

frames.name: walk_1
frames.prompt: The same lizard walking: front-right and back-left legs forward, body swaying.

frames.name: walk_2
frames.prompt: The same lizard walking: legs passing under the body, body level.

frames.name: walk_3
frames.prompt: The same lizard walking: front-left and back-right legs forward.

frames.name: walk_4
frames.prompt: The same lizard walking: legs passing under the body again.

frames.name: windup_1
frames.prompt: The same lizard stopping and crouching: front lowered, head drawn back, tail flicking up.

frames.name: windup_2
frames.prompt: The same lizard fully coiled to charge: chest to the ground, head cocked back, tail lashed high, eyes narrowed.

frames.name: charge_1
frames.prompt: The same lizard bursting into a charge: body stretched forward, head thrust ahead, legs kicking back.

frames.name: charge_2
frames.prompt: The same lizard at full sprint: fully stretched and low, head plate forward like a ram.

frames.name: charge_3
frames.prompt: The same lizard in the last stride of the charge, legs gathered, head still forward.

frames.name: rest_1
frames.prompt: The same lizard after the charge: skidding to a stop, head low and panting, mouth open.

frames.name: rest_2
frames.prompt: The same lizard exhausted and panting, sides heaving, head hanging low, tail limp.

frames.name: stunned
frames.prompt: The same lizard dazed: head drooping, eyes half shut, legs splayed, swaying.

frames.name: hurt
frames.prompt: The same lizard flinching from a hit: body arched, mouth open in a hiss, eyes shut tight.

frames.name: downed
frames.prompt: The same lizard lying on its back, pale belly up, legs curled and limp, tail flopped to the side.
